If you can imagine it, I've probably already done it. Learn to play less bad directly from Balatro's most winning-est player. Welcome to Balatro University.

BalatroU has a bunch of talented artists, but Kitty is the one who did most of the emotes you see in the video thumbnails. She does pixel art, too, including many of the Jokers for the Extra Credit Mod.
